2026 General Election

 
November 3, 2026
 General Election 
 

 A General Election is the election in which federal and state officers, members of Congress and of the general assembly, county and township officers, and other officers appear on the ballot. General Elections are held the 1st Tuesday after the 1st Monday in November of each even-numbered year. 

 
 
The General Election will be held on Tuesday, November 3, 2026. 
 
 

Important Dates and Information

Voter Registration 
 

The pre-registration deadline for voter registration closes at 5:00 p.m. on Monday, October 19, 2026. 
 

After the pre-registration deadline, you must prove who you are (ID) and where you live (residence).  The best document to bring is your valid Iowa driver's license with your current address.  Election Day Registration can be completed at your polling place on Election Day, when voting absentee in person at the courthouse, or when voting absentee in person at a satellite location. 
 

Voters registering after October 19 should expect a longer processing time. 
 

More Information on Registering to Vote 
 
 

Vote on Election Day 
 
 
 
Polls will be open from 7:00 a.m. to 8:00 p.m. on Tuesday, November 3, 2026.  Voters must vote at their assigned polling location.  List of Polling Locations 
 
Voters will need to provide identification at the polls.  View acceptable forms of voter identification 
 
The Election Office will be open to answer general questions. 
 
There is no voting at the Election Office on Election Day. 
 
 
 

Vote Before Election Day: Vote-by-Mail 
 
 
 
Absentee ballot request forms are being accepted now for the General Election. 
 
The first day absentee ballots can be mailed is Wednesday, October 14, 2026. 
 
The deadline to submit an absentee ballot request form is 5:00 p.m. on Monday, October 19, 2026.  Request forms must be in the office by 5:00 p.m.  Postmarks do not count. 
 
 

Requests for absentee ballots must be in writing and should be mailed or delivered to: 
 

Black Hawk County Elections
 
316 E. 5th Street
 
Waterloo, IA 50703 
 

Voted absentee ballots must be received in the Election Office by 8:00 p.m. on Election Day.  Voters casting their absentee ballot under UOCAVA or Safe at Home should review their absentee ballot instructions for additional guidance. 
 

More Information on Absentee Voting 
 
 

Vote Before Election Day: Absentee Voting In Person 
 

Absentee voting in person (early voting) is available at the Black Hawk County Courthouse and at the satellite locations listed below.  Any eligible Black Hawk County voter may vote at the courthouse or at any satellite location.  Voters will need to provide identification when voting absentee in person.  View acceptable forms of voter identification 
 

At the Courthouse (Basement Conference Room) 
 
 
 
Absentee voting in person will begin on Wednesday, October 14, 2026. 
 
Absentee voting in person will be open from 8:00 a.m. to 4:30 p.m., Monday through Friday, plus the extended hours listed below. 
 
Absentee voting in person will end at 4:30 p.m. on Monday, November 2, 2026.

Satellite locations are open only on the dates and hours listed below.

Extended hours are available at the Election Office for voter registration and absentee voting.  In addition to regular hours (Monday through Friday, 8:00 a.m. to 4:30 p.m.), extended office hours will be:

Friday, October 30, 2026: 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m. 
 
Saturday, October 31, 2026: 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m.
